items.title: Johnson v. Inos is filed
items.body: Retirees sue in the U.S. District Court for the NMI over the Government’s unpaid contributions to the Retirement Fund (Case No. 09-00023).

items.title: The Retirement Fund files for bankruptcy
items.body: Years of unpaid contributions leave the Fund nearly empty. The court later dismisses the filing.

items.title: The settlement
items.body: The court approves the class-action settlement. The new Settlement Fund takes over Retirement Fund assets and must pay members at least 75% of their full benefits, backed by annual Government payments.

items.title: Payments peak
items.body: The required Minimum Annual Payment reaches $45 million, then declines each year after.

items.title: Health insurance and the 25% in doubt
items.body: The Fund warns of lapsing health coverage and says the Government has no funding for 25% payments beyond December 31.

items.title: The 25% payments stop
items.body: The Fund issues cessation notices in June and July. The FY 2026 payment status references an MPLT loan.
